This small plot of perennial crops has been with our family for many years, and I take care of it the way my mother taught me. I will spread cow dung and compost around the plants because that keeps them healthy, but I do not have chemical fertilizer for this plot and I do not think it is needed. These plants are already well established, so I am not planting any new seeds this season. My children and I can manage the weeding and any harvesting ourselves on this small piece of land.
